mod.cannedmonster.name: CannedMonster
tooltip.cannedmonster.small: Can fuse; an empty can used or thrown at a fused mob peels one member at a time, but cannot store the whole fusion
tooltip.cannedmonster.large: Can capture and store fused mobs; an empty large can extracts all members at once
tooltip.cannedmonster.hand: Use on a mob to capture/fuse; hold and release an empty can to extract a member; use on a block to release
tooltip.cannedmonster.hand_large: Use on a mob to capture/fuse; hold and release an empty large can to extract all members at once; use on a block to release
tooltip.cannedmonster.eat: Hold use to finish eating a filled can; release early to cancel. Press and release again with an empty can to extract a member
tooltip.cannedmonster.eat_large: Hold use to finish eating a filled can; release early to cancel. Press and release again with an empty large can to extract all members at once
tooltip.cannedmonster.throw: Hold use to charge, release to throw; captures or peels on hit, throw straight up to hit yourself
tooltip.cannedmonster.random: Spawns a random mob on block impact; consumed on success
tooltip.cannedmonster.spatial_pending: Spatial behavior is not implemented yet
tooltip.cannedmonster.spatial_empty: Spatial room: use a mob to admit it, use air/a block to enter
tooltip.cannedmonster.spatial_ready: Spatial room established with %s resident(s); use air/a block to enter
tooltip.cannedmonster.spatial_use: The client receives a virtual room view; right-click a wall/floor/ceiling to exit
message.cannedmonster.space_anchor_faile: Could not leave the external can anchor; entry cancelled
message.cannedmonster.space_anchor_lost: The external can anchor is missing; still inside
message.cannedmonster.space_teleport_fai: Space teleport failed; entry rolled back
message.cannedmonster.space_capture_fail: Could not admit the mob; changes rolled back
message.cannedmonster.space_too_large: That mob is too large for the room
message.cannedmonster.space_shattered: The space can was destroyed; everything was ejected
message.cannedmonster.space_recovered: Recovered the lost space anchor as a can at its last position
message.cannedmonster.space_anchor_prese: The space anchor still exists; recovery refused
